modules.module_title: Perform quality checks and suggest solutions

pcs.pc_description: perform quality checks keeping the various stages of carpet manufacturing.

conduct checks on critical areas which could hamper the final output. some of these quality checks are as follows:a. dyeing: checks if there are any uneven or patchy stains on the carpet, wool not dyed as per design map etc.b. washing: checks whether the carpet is washed properly with appropriate chemicals, color fade etc.c. weaving: ensure that there is no uneven pile cutting, no broken threads, wrong weaving design, holes other than weaving pattern etc.d. latexing and third- backing: ensure that latex is dried properly, tufted withdrawal force is adequate, there are no defects in third backing, proper pasting of nevaar etc.e. binding: ensure the carpet is stitched properly from all ends.f. embossing: ensure that design is appearing over the yarn pile and is visible properly; yarn is not overlapping the design etc.g. finishing: ensure that carpet is sheared and trimmed properly, there are no dusts or any metal or spools on the carpet, it is not torn from anywhere, colors are matching in terms of their finish, the final product is matching with the buyers requirements.h. packing: ensure that labelling is done, color codes are marked, bar codes are there, carpet is cleaned and properly rolled etc.
suggest solutions at every stage where the defects are found.
ensures that end product is free from any defect.
provides final approval and sign on the clearance receipt.
informs management on some anticipated delays on account of quality.
explain clearly the reason for delays and corrective action taken to expedite.
communicate tentative timelines by when the defect shall be addressed.
seek management views and advise.
demonstrate ownership and responsibility.
